# Retroactive support billing on reactivation

# Retroactive support billing on reactivation — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Retroactive support billing on reactivation. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] After cancellation of Developer or self-serve Pro, Atlas reactivation of paid support triggers charges back to the date a non-Basic support plan was last active, capped at a 90-day lookback, except when moving from Developer to self-serve Pro or from self-serve Pro to subscription-linked Pro. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/support/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Atlas support page says cancellation during a trial stops billing immediately; cancellation outside a trial takes effect at month-end, with billing continuing until then. It also says changing support plans changes billing on the first day of the next month. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/support.md
- [statement] The Atlas support page inspected in this probe does not specify a support-reactivation lookback window or a retroactive charge for an inactive support interval. This is a documentation gap, not proof that every Atlas agreement excludes such charges. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/support.md
- [statement] Atlas exempts two transitions from retroactive billing: Developer to self-serve Pro, and self-serve Pro to subscription-linked Pro. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/support/
- [statement] Atlas cancellation outside a trial takes effect at month-end, with billing continuing until then; trial cancellation stops billing immediately. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/support/
